newsitem.title: CHINA: GPT sets up second China joint venture in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: GPT sets up second China joint venture in Shanghai.

text.p: GPT Ltd of Britain signed an agreement with Shanghai Railway Communications Equipment Factory to set up a joint venture to make equipment for China's optical fibre network, the company said in a statement on Wednesday.
Each party will hold 50 percent of the Shanghai GPT Telecommunications Equipment Co, it said but gave no investment amount.

The plant, in the Waigaoqiao Free Trade zone in the Pudong New Area of Shanghai, will manufacture synchronous digital hierarchy (SDH) equipment for China's transmission systems infrastructure, which already uses GPT's SDH equipment in many of its optical fibre networks, it said.
China already has 15,000 km of SDH lines, including a line stretching 3,000 km from the southwest city Chongqing to Shanghai, it said.
The Shanghai plant is GPT's second joint venture in China and shows the company's long-term commitment to the Chinese market, it added but gave no further details.
The joint venture aims at sales worth $150 million over the next five years, 80 percent from the Ministry of Railways and China United Telecommunications Corp, the China Daily said on Wednesday.
